conf.description: Forcepoint DLP system/health log, syslog/CEF (10.2+), per recommendations.direct.cribl. Same transport and CEF header/extension parse as the incident pipeline; branches on the 'DLP System Log' Name header. Two distinct times: localTime (generationTime) carries a timezone and is the real event time (-> _time); timeStamp (insertionTime) is DB insertion time (-> event.ingested), and the generation-to-insertion lag is itself a health signal. Not a detection stream - the real deliverable is absence detection when a policy engine, protector, or endpoint agent stops reporting.

functions.description: Split the 7 pipe-delimited CEF header fields from the extension string.

Extract every CEF extension key=value pair. Non-greedy value + lookahead on the next key= (or end of string) so multi-word values like msg are not cut at the first space, which a naive kv splitter would do.
Keep only system-log records, discriminated by the 'DLP System Log' Name header.
Batch-rename every status:mapped/partial-but-direct field to its ECS target. src is not a network address here despite the CEF key name.

Number.code (no published vendor code table - review queue, see README); insertion time to event.ingested (day-first, no offset, assumed UTC); relocate Topic and SourceType to forcepoint.dlp.system.*.
Fallback event time from the syslog header, used only if localTime is absent or unparseable.
Set _time from localTime, the only timestamp in this stream carrying a timezone (exact format unverified against live output - see README); tag event.dataset.
